title: folder-sync prefix pointer, version 1
description: The body of a <version>.<size>.prefix object under _history/ (PEP 0009): about 125 bytes saying that this version's bytes are the first `size` bytes of the path's next full object, the oldest keyframe (.zst or whole) after it in version order, or the live file when there is none. A reader fetches `bytes=0-(size-1)` of that object (a .zst anchor is decoded first) and accepts the result only if its sha256 is `sha256` and starts with the sha16 in the name. The engine writes it compact, as {"schema":"folder-sync-prefix/1","size":<n>,"sha256":"<64 hex>"}, created once. See docs/CONTRACT.md, 'Deletions and history'.

size.description: This version's own size in bytes, the <size> in the object's name; at least 1.

sha256.description: The sha256 of this version's bytes; the name's sha16 is its first 16 digits.
